items.text: Giants GM Schoen: Tyrone Tracy Jr. placed on IR with hamstring; min 4 games.
items.implication: Skattebo lead + Singletary elevated for 4+ weeks
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for remaining Giants RBs

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in weekend fantasy injury summary.
items.implication: Huntley continues; Flowers/Henry usage elevated without dual-threat
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers YPRR lead remains unlocked less fully

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos RBs in snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins 21%, Harvey fluky TD. Roster in 100% leagues.
items.why: 50/41/34% shares on return; Payton wants more touches

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Doyle/Lamar unlock.
items.why: Elite YPRR + scheme with healthy Lamar
items.implication: Massive ceiling boost on Lamar return

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 PPR PPG via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.implication: Volume sustains fantasy value regardless of YPC

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if self-injured avoiding TD.
items.implication: No missed time expected; RB1 usage continues

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT.
Puka Nacua GTD with optimism; path to ACTIVE.
items.implication: Likely full or near role if active

items.opportunity: Jets RB committee shift if out

items.text: Bucky Irving not talked about enough as workhorse RB.
Josh Jacobs back; discuss ROS fantasy value for Packers RB.
items.implication: Solid RB2/flex ROS with goal-line work

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (lead), Tank Dell only 6 in return, Noel 15 (turf toe early exit).
items.why: 24 routes lead far ahead of Dell
items.implication: Clear alpha WR1 role post-Dell return
